# dumbtv home

> A home screen (launcher) for Amazon Fire TV, set up over ADB from a computer without root:
> your apps and HDMI inputs, a sleep timer, night mode, weather, and a photo screen saver that
> also runs over paused apps, with OLED burn-in care. Plain Java, no libraries. Tested on Fire
> OS 6 (Android 7.1); Fire OS 7 should work; Fire OS 8 and non-Amazon TVs are not supported.
> A fork of humblemuzzu/dumbtv; upstream's debloat scripts are kept but are not part of the setup.

Agents: read `AGENTS.md`, ask the user which TV and computer they have, then run
`./launcher/install.sh` and verify with the commands in AGENTS.md. Never run `scripts/all.sh`
or `scripts/debloat.sh` on a Fire OS 6 television.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup contract for agents (rules, steps, expected output, recovery) and a map of the code
- [README.md](README.md): the same setup for a person, step by step
- [launcher/GETTING-STARTED.md](launcher/GETTING-STARTED.md): using the home screen, for the household
- [launcher/README.md](launcher/README.md): how it works inside, the settings file, building, testing
- [docs/GOTCHAS.md](docs/GOTCHAS.md): Fire OS failure modes found while building upstream
- [docs/OTHER-TVS.md](docs/OTHER-TVS.md): which TVs can and cannot run a custom home screen

## Upstream (optional, not part of this setup)

- [docs/DEBLOAT.md](docs/DEBLOAT.md), [docs/DEBLOAT-AGENTS.md](docs/DEBLOAT-AGENTS.md): the debloat and DNS-filter tool
- [skills/firetv-debloat/SKILL.md](skills/firetv-debloat/SKILL.md): the same as a loadable skill
- [catalog/devices/](catalog/devices/): per-model menu paths and quirks
